reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the redline is identical to the original paragraphs with no comment, which is the expected output for a compliant finding.

Cited text substantively supports compliance with the preferred position: Section 2(a) grants a 'non-exclusive' licence and expressly states Client 'is not obligated to utilize the License' and is 'free to acquire, develop, license or otherwise utilize any other hardware, software system...' — an affirmative non-exclusivity/freedom-to-source provision rather than mere silence.

No sole-supplier, requirements-purchase, or 'shall not procure from any third party' obligation binding Customer appears in the cited material; the deterministic check confirms no such obligation remains.

The Section 3(i) captive-ordering commitment is correctly treated as a noted minor point rather than a deviation: it applies only to transactions the Customer voluntarily routes through the Interface and does not restrict Customer's general purchasing freedom, so it does not fail the fallback.

'Exclusive' references identified (non-exclusive licence to Client, Client's nonexclusive grant of Credit Data to TrueLink, exclusive forum) correctly run in our favour or are outside this rule's scope, consistent with the detection guidance.
Flagging the separate Non-Competition Agreement for diligence is appropriate as rationale rather than a redline, since that document is not before us.
